name: sheet
useFor: Use for detail or settings that sit beside the page (a pull request's checks, sandbox settings) without leaving it. Open from the right by default; side="left" for navigation, "top" or "bottom" for a band. Put the title in SheetHeader and the actions in SheetFooter with one ink Button. On phones use Drawer for a swipeable bottom sheet.
constraints: A sheet wider than half the screen on desktop
A sheet that opens another sheet
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: the square ground panel and quiet line of its popups (.hn__sheet), the dock curve its frames slide on (--dock) and its long soft cast.
title: Sheet
description: A square full-height panel of the ground, 384px wide, ruled off by the quiet line and casting the long soft shadow over the page under the ink at 32 percent, with a Chakra Petch light 20px title, a 14px graphite description, footer keys at the end and a compact ghost X. It slides its own width on the dock curve. A long body scrolls inside the panel and fades at the edge it scrolls past (fade-y).
